summary: Defined community artifact sandbox-only policy and promotion requirements.
acceptance_evidence: Community artifacts are sandbox-only and non-promotable by default.
Community artifacts cannot broaden host authority by default.
Promotion requires signatures, replay, revocation metadata and organization allowlist or verified publisher status.
Operator projection and support bundles must surface community risk.

commands.summary: Adversarial community-like fixture behavior remains denied before EffectPrepared.

blocked_shortcuts: Community artifacts cannot skip directly to core.
Discovery and staging do not imply activation.
Community artifacts cannot self-grant policy authority.
promotion_impact: Community ecosystem discovery can grow without weakening Production Distro defaults.
